description: Cut audio from a YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram URL and return a short-lived download link. Lead with download_url for cut/download requests; offer editor_url when the user wants to tweak the selection. Links expire after about an hour — ask again in chat for a fresh cut if expired. Omit start_sec and end_sec for the full track. format defaults to mp3 (wav allowed). clip_id and peaks drive the interactive clip card some chat apps show; do not show them to the user. If the user adjusted the clip in the card, read the widget context for the current range and download link before answering follow-ups.

duration_sec.description: Clip length in seconds from start_sec (default 0) when end_sec is omitted

url.description: YouTube, TikTok, or Instagram URL to cut

name: cut_audio
title: Cut audio
